The line stays `[note] -> once:start-lane-silent-undo-appended-negation`, so the lane's inbox check stays open. Same family as your item 818 (a different line, a different lane).
Based on (record): the coordinator's 01:48 CST message, relayed, refusal text quoted there; triage read none of the lane's files. Ruling own-818-c-owner-edit (read by triage): the edit is yours or a session you name. Meanwhile: the lane's PR #3387 is with runner 10 and does not wait on this; the lane's Stop costs one extra turn at most (the hook documents it; untested by triage).
